Initial release: APIDot Claude 4.6 API skill (documentation-only)

- Provides guidance for integrating Claude 4.6 models (Sonnet & Opus) via APIDot, including production chat, coding agents, and tool use planning.
- Includes instructions on using APIDot with Anthropic-style Messages API and chat completions.
- Lists security best practices for managing APIDot API keys.
- Details workflow steps for routing Claude 4.6 requests to the correct APIDot docs and model pages.
- Outlines when to use this skill versus the broader APIDot skill, and includes official links for docs, quickstart, examples, and support.
- No scripts, automation, or live API calls included—documentation only.
